name: Dirty repos
author: mmilei
description: Counts the git repositories under a folder that have uncommitted changes or commits not pushed; the panel lists them with branch and what is pending, and a click opens a terminal in the repo.

barWidget.description: Git glyph with the number of repos that need attention; click for the list.

schema.label: Root folder
schema.description: Folder whose git repositories are scanned.

schema.label: Search depth
schema.description: How many folder levels below the root to look in (1 = direct children).

schema.label: Refresh, panel open (s)
schema.description: Seconds between full scans while the panel is open.

schema.label: Change check, panel closed (s)
schema.description: Seconds between cheap change checks while the panel is closed.
